title: Clear every unresolved SonarCloud issue and seed tenant console menus during provisioning
goal: Main f6579ad8 fails the SonarCloud quality gate on new_security_rating = 3.0 (one S2068 hard-coded password), and release-gate.yml additionally requires zero unresolved issues while 32 are open. The previous S2068 fix only moved the literal into an env fallback, so Sonar still saw a constant credential. This task removes the constant entirely (the smoke password is generated per run and recorded in the fixture manifest), clears the remaining 31 code smells by refactoring rather than by exclusion or dismissal, and fixes the regression that made Tenant Smoke fail on every commit after the remediation merge: tenant provisioning created the roles and Casbin policies but never wrote system_role_menu, so a new tenant administrator signed in to a console with an empty sidebar.
findings: S2068 (P0): frontend/tests/smoke-core/tenant-fixture.ts kept 'SmokeMatrix#2026' as an env fallback, so the credential stayed hard-coded and new_security_rating stayed at 3.0 after the previous fix.
go:S1192 x9 (P1): duplicated SQL predicates and message keys (token.invalid, created_at desc id desc, system.tenant, tenant_id = ?, role_id = ?, id = ?, id <> ?, status = ?).
go:S3776 x3 / typescript:S3776 x1 (P1): GetCurrentTenant 16, the F10 data-scope test 16, provisionTenantRoleBindings 26, submitForm 20 — all over the 15 budget.
godre:S8193 x2 / godre:S8196 x1 (P2): a single-use temporary and a single-method interface named after its noun instead of its method.
typescript:S9382 x6 (P2): sequential awaits over independent tenants, members and dictionary fixtures.

typescript:S3358 x2 / S6759 x3 / S6819 x1 / S5843 x1 / go:S1135 x1 (P2): nested ternaries, mutable props, role=status instead of <output>, an over-complex zero-time regex, and a TODO in a doc comment.
Tenant Smoke regression (P0): provisioning never wrote system_role_menu, so a freshly provisioned tenant resolved an empty navigation tree and the console had no sidebar.

out: Excluding files from .sonarcloud.properties to hide findings
Bulk-marking issues as won't fix through the SonarCloud API
Adding a tenant dimension to system_menu (menu rows stay global; only the grant is tenant-scoped)

implementationNotes: The S2068 root cause is a literal credential in the source tree. An env fallback keeps the literal, which is why the finding only changed line number. The password is now generated per run with randomBytes and written into the fixture manifest, so specs and teardown read the same value.

The six S9382 sites are genuinely independent (two tenants, their members, their dictionary fixtures), so Promise.all is safe. This does not contradict the earlier decision to keep delete ordering sequential in the smoke helpers.
provisionTenantRoleBindings was split without changing order or idempotency: read the platform admin bindings, then per role read the existing set and insert only the missing rows.
Menu seeding excludes module = 'system.tenant' so a tenant administrator never sees the platform-level tenant console entry.
TenantScopedRepository is kept as a deprecated alias so downstream repositories do not have to change code in a minor release.

Whether the 31 code smells had to reach zero, rather than relaxing the release-gate rule, is a governance decision. This packet follows the existing gate.
